item.title: How Do We Grade the Rollout for Madonna’s ‘Confessions II’? Greatest Pop Stars Podcast
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the Greatest Pop Stars podcast! I'm your host, Andrew Unterberger, and today we're talking about the long-awaited release of Madonna's album, Confessions II. Joining me are Billboard staffers Eric Frankenberg and Joe Lynch.
Eric and Joe, thanks for being here! Madonna fans have been waiting for this album for at least two years. What are your first impressions of Confessions II?
[Short pause for discussion]
Host: The early returns have been almost uniformly positive, with rave reviews and a potential No. 1 debut on the Billboard 200. We're grading all aspects of the rollout, from live performances to the 10-minute mini-movie accompanying the album.
Eric, what do you think of Madonna's high-profile live performances, like her Times Square show?
[Short pause for Eric's response]
Host: Joe, do you think Madonna's last two decades of albums are underappreciated? And how does the Sabrina Carpenter duet compare to her classic teamup with Britney Spears?
[Short pause for Joe's response]
Host: We're also discussing whether "Danceteria" is already part of the all-time Madonna canon, and how Lourdes' presence adds to the overall album cycle. Is Confessions II a worthy sequel to the original?
[Short pause for discussion]
Host: Check out our YouTube playlist of the most important moments from this old-school album campaign, and subscribe to our podcast on Apple Music or Spotify for weekly discussions about pop stardom. Thanks for tuning in, and don't forget to support a great cause, like the Transgender Law Center or the Human Rights Campaign.
[Outro music plays]
